target.statement: PGKD test accuracy on Cora (transductive, SAGE teacher) = 82.15%

compute.basis: Cora is tiny (2708 nodes) and CPU-trainable, but no code is released, so the full PGKD pipeline (SAGE teacher + prototype losses + 5-seed protocol) must be reimplemented from the paper text.
